_: The realm's matters (bridge/matters/*.js; Mac 2026-11-16: 'is this really filled with tension?'). answers: at most this many answers a matter offers, before Leave it. leave: Leave it's words (label; shrinks and alone, its cost said when no house's favour moves). silence: what saying nothing costs, in a house's favour, kind by kind (the town's or house's own; loyalWonder each loyal house; warLeft each of the two at war). attack: a foe on a town of the realm, its lines by how it came ({house} {town}), foe (an unnamed one), why, defend (the answer that sends a host).

attack.why: A town of the realm looks to its King. Send a host, call the banners or raise new men; left alone it may fall, and its house remembers who came.
